purpose: A by-value foreach retains its original array while caller writes separate the global source array. Pending throw and explicit Generator close separate item CV retirement, current getters and old iterator-array lifetime from the immediately discarded new source array.
source:
<?php
class ReviewParkedLoopOldA23 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewParkedLoopOldB23 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
class ReviewParkedLoopNewC23 { function __destruct() { echo "CNEW|"; } }
class ReviewParkedLoopNewD23 { function __destruct() { echo "DNEW|"; } }
function reviewParkedLoopCowLeaf23() { global $items; try { echo "C|"; foreach ($items as $item) { unset($items); echo "V|"; yield 7 => 5; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewParkedLoopCowMiddle23() { try { echo "M|"; yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewParkedLoopCowOuter23() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$items = [new ReviewParkedLoopOldA23(), new ReviewParkedLoopOldB23()]; $exception = new Exception("foreach-cow23");
$child = reviewParkedLoopCowLeaf23(); $middle = reviewParkedLoopCowMiddle23(); $outer = reviewParkedLoopCowOuter23();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); echo "H|";
$items[0] = new ReviewParkedLoopNewC23(); $items[1] = new ReviewParkedLoopNewD23(); echo "W|";
unset($items); echo "DROP|";
try { $middle->throw($exception); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; }
catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught === $exception ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "GET|", $middle->current(), "|", $middle->key(), "|", $middle->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|";
unset($caught, $exception); echo "E";

purpose: The suspended by-value iterator array embeds a shared reference cell. After pending throw and all Generator retirement, rebinding that cell must affect the retained container rather than preserving a flattened pin to its former referent; the unvisited object and new referent discriminate late ownership.

<?php

class ReviewParkedLoopCellB23 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
class ReviewParkedLoopCellC23 { function __destruct() { echo "CNEW|"; } }
function reviewParkedLoopCellLeaf23() { global $slot; try { echo "C|"; foreach ([&$slot, new ReviewParkedLoopCellB23()] as $item) { unset($slot); echo "V|"; yield 3 => 11; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewParkedLoopCellMiddle23() { try { echo "M|"; yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewParkedLoopCellOuter23() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$slot = new ReviewParkedLoopCellA23(); $exception = new Exception("foreach-cell23");
$child = reviewParkedLoopCellLeaf23(); $middle = reviewParkedLoopCellMiddle23(); $outer = reviewParkedLoopCellOuter23();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); echo "H|";
try { $middle->throw($exception); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; }
catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught === $exception ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "GET|", $middle->current(), "|", $middle->key(), "|", $middle->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|";
$slot = new ReviewParkedLoopCellC23(); echo "WRITE|"; unset($slot); echo "UNSET|";
unset($caught, $exception); echo "E";
